doRules: Open with a high-stakes conflict or specific number in the first 2.5 seconds (under 12 words).
Combine the core story with 1-2 sharp analytical takeaways so the script is 100% transformative.
Switch visual B-roll keywords every 4 to 5 seconds to reset viewer attention.
Make the final sentence flow grammatically into the first word of the hook for a seamless loop.
dontRules: Never start with 'Today we are talking about' or 'A user on Reddit posted'.
Avoid passive voice or sentences longer than 18 words.
Do not give away the final resolution before the last 5 seconds.
